$comment: TIER 3 — MCP servers for this project. Part of the swap set (agent.config.json + CLAUDE.md + rules/guards.rules + .mcp.json); another project ships its own. Two independent Replit deployments, each with its OWN url + bearer token via env — nothing hardcoded. Server KEYS below become the mcp__<key>__<tool> prefixes the agents call, and match the live deployments. (a) Memory_Assist = mcp-assist-memory, the project-agnostic memory/coordination server (Postgres+pgvector); the hook path (lib/server_sync.py) talks to it over raw HTTP and does NOT depend on this file — this entry registers the same server as tools for the orchestrator. (b) canvas-sdk-tools = the static/offline Canvas validator (no PHI, no live Canvas access); the audit agents call its tools by name.
